name: DFI Inc.
summary: Established in 1981 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, DFI Inc. operates as a global leader in the design, manufacturing, and distribution of sophisticated board and system-level products for diverse embedded applications. DFI offers a comprehensive range of hardware, including robust industrial motherboards and various System-on-Modules (SoMs) like mini, compact, basic, Qseven, carrier boards, and smart display units. Their industrial computer line features fanless, high-performance, medical, in-vehicle, railway, and gaming embedded systems, as well as pre-configured systems, chassis, and digital signage OPS/OPS+ computers. Additionally, DFI provides an extensive selection of industrial panel PCs and displays, such as fanless and high-performance touch panels, transportation-specific touch panels, medical, and general industrial panel PCs, alongside bar-type displays and various other industrial and touch screen solutions. Beyond hardware, DFI extends its expertise through OEM/ODM services. They also offer comprehensive customization for BIOS, operating systems (OS), and other software. Furthermore, their services include design manufacturing support and dependable technical assistance. These solutions are deployed across a multitude of sectors, including industrial automation, healthcare, gaming, transportation, energy, mission-critical operations, and intelligent retail environments.
